Whether the Entra account a row was carried out for moved

entra_account_change.Rd

Item 11 of the 0.27.0 (decided on 2026-11-12). The username a row was carried out for is compared with the account whose identifier the channel wrote at the first execution, applied_entra_id, against the sweep whole, guests included: a username is unique in the tenant, not among its members.

Usage

entra_account_change(
  executed_username,
  believed_id,
  directory,
  revoked = FALSE,
  folds = directory_folds(directory)
)

Arguments

executed_username

The username the row was carried out for.

believed_id

The identifier believed, never empty.

directory

The sweep, as directory_users() returns it.

revoked

Whether the row asks for revoked.

folds

The sweep folded, directory_folds(), made from directory; by default folded here.

Value

A list with code, one of the two codes or "", and upn, the username the account of the identifier carries now when it was renamed, "" otherwise.

Details

  • The username carried out is another account's, one with another identifier: TRASPORTO_NOME_RIASSEGNATO, unless the row is revoked. A revoked row governs its pair, and taking away is the direction that does not grant.

  • Nobody carries the username carried out, and the account of the identifier is in the sweep under another username: TRASPORTO_ACCOUNT_RINOMINATO, with that username.

  • Nobody carries it and the identifier is not in the sweep, the account deleted and its name not given again: nothing, pair_change() decides as before.

  • The username carried out is the account of the identifier: nothing.

  • Two accounts with the same username, or with the same identifier, a sweep this package does not understand: nothing.

Pure: the caller asks only on a row whose version carried out is certain, with an identifier believed, and that does not leave by revocation_exits().
